steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters in the software: Number of tubes (e.g., 2), Number of Slides (choose 1‑6), Spot Spacing (user‑defined), Spot Volume (user‑defined), Aspiration Flow Rate (default 1, optional 1.2 for +20% or 0.5 for half), Dispense Flow Rate (default 1, optional 1.2 for +20% or 0.5 for half), and select the P20 Single‑Channel Mount (left or right).

steps.title: Prepare slides and tubes
steps.instruction: Place up to 6 slides, each containing 8 wells, on the deck. Ensure tube 1 and tube 2 contain the appropriate antibody solutions and are positioned for pipette access.

steps.title: Aspirate from tube 1 and dispense top‑left spots
steps.instruction: Using the P20 single‑channel pipette at the specified aspiration flow rate, aspirate the user‑specified Spot Volume from tube 1, then dispense that volume into the top‑left spot of every other well starting with well 2 (i.e., wells 2, 4, 6, 8) for each slide position.

steps.title: Aspirate from tube 2 and dispense bottom‑left spots
steps.instruction: Using the same pipette at the specified aspiration flow rate, aspirate the user‑specified Spot Volume from tube 2, then dispense that volume into the bottom‑left spot of every other well starting with well 3 (i.e., wells 3, 5, 7) for each slide position.

steps.title: Repeat spotting until slides filled
steps.instruction: Repeat the two dispensing cycles (steps 3 and 4) for all slide plate positions until each slide’s wells 2‑7 have received the 8 dots as described, completing the spotting of all specified slides.
